run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T09:42:41Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy coincides with real, self-observed frontend-proxy 5xx errors, which are upstream response timeouts on POST /api/checkout (504, 15000 ms) relayed from frontend: traces and checkout logs show checkout's Kafka producer ('orders publish') failing with 'circuit breaker is open' and 'kafka server: Request was for a topic or partition that does not exist on this broker', with PlaceOrder taking ~97 s. The deepest supported fault is the otel-demo kafka Deployment, which runs 2 replicas while its pod template configures a single-voter KRaft quorum (KAFKA_CONTROLLER_QUORUM_VOTERS=1@kafka:9093) and the kafka Service load-balances port 9092 across both pods; broker kafka-ff7884766-xclnk repeatedly logs requests as brokerId=1/brokerEpoch=10 rejected with 'Expected broker epoch 17, but got broker epoch 10', and partition/directory assignments keep failing, so the 'orders' topic cannot be served. A second, later fault is the Chaos Mesh NetworkChaos series otel-demo-checkout-kafka-network-partition-* (9 experiments, 10:02:10-10:10:10) partitioning checkout-5dccddf8bb-vn95l and both kafka pods, which matches a distinct error surge between 10:01 and 10:13 but starts ~20 minutes after the alert. An additional frontend-proxy 500 via_upstream on GET /api/data remains unexplained. The alerting rule itself is not present in this Prometheus, so the reported value 1.6 could not be reconciled.

claims.text: frontend-proxy is the only service with substantial ERROR-status spans: at 10:20:41 its 'ingress' operation had 83.35 error spans in the preceding 600 s, while checkout, frontend, accounting, payment, ad and fraud-detection were 0 and recommendation was 1.28.

frontend-proxy error spans were already present at the first returned metric point: the 5-minute increase of 'ingress' spans with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR was 54.68 at 09:43:41, 95-151 through 09:57-10:01, peaked at 372.2 at 10:07:41 and fell to 44.44 at 10:16:41.
frontend-proxy 'router frontend egress' spans with STATUS_CODE_ERROR were 0 up to 10:00:41, first nonzero at 10:01:41 (15.6 per 300 s), peaked at 231.1 at 10:05:41, and returned to 0 from 10:13:41.

frontend-proxy access logs between 09:49:06 and 09:49:53 show only one 5xx class: 'POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 504 UT response_timeout ... 15000/15001 ms' with upstream 'frontend', i.e. upstream response timeouts rather than refused connections.

Trace 2bcbe90cc590bd3b2ef1765253f6989b (started 09:58:14) shows load-generator POST (504) -> frontend-proxy 'ingress' (504, 15.0 s) -> frontend-proxy 'router frontend egress' (error=true, http.status_code=0) -> frontend POST /api/checkout -> checkout 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' (97.66 s) whose child checkout 'orders publish' failed with otel.status_description 'circuit breaker is open'.

In the sampled error traces from 09:58-10:00, checkout 'orders publish' spans also carry the diagnostic text 'kafka server: Request was for a topic or partition that does not exist on this broker' (in addition to 'circuit breaker is open').

checkout-5dccddf8bb-vn95l logs 'Failed to write message: kafka: Failed to produce message to topic orders: circuit breaker is open' and, at 10:10:49, 'client/metadata got error from broker 1 while fetching metadata: read tcp 100.96.1.134:53048->100.71.78.255:9092: i/o timeout'.

Service otel-demo/kafka exposes plaintext port 9092 with clusterIP 100.71.78.255 and selector opentelemetry.io/name=kafka, and its Endpoints contain both kafka pods: kafka-ff7884766-skk8d (100.96.2.21) and kafka-ff7884766-xclnk (100.96.4.61).

Deployment otel-demo/kafka has spec.replicas=2 with 2 ready/available replicas (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-kafka) while its container env sets KAFKA_CONTROLLER_QUORUM_VOTERS=1@kafka:9093, KAFKA_CONTROLLER_LISTENER_NAMES=CONTROLLER, KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS=PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092 and KAFKA_LISTENERS=PLAINTEXT://:9092,CONTROLLER://:9093, with no readiness or liveness probe.

kafka-ff7884766-xclnk logs '[QuorumController id=1] assignReplicasToDirs: event failed with StaleBrokerEpochException ... Expected broker epoch 17, but got broker epoch 10' about every 10 s, with AssignReplicasToDirsRequestData(brokerId=1, brokerEpoch=10) covering 50 partitions, at least from 09:48:08 through 10:11:11.

kafka-ff7884766-skk8d logs at 09:56-10:11 show '[QuorumController id=1] CreateTopics ... __consumer_offsets ... TOPIC_ALREADY_EXISTS', repeated 'Sent auto-creation request for Set(orders) to the active controller', and '[AssignmentsManager id=1] handleResponse: 50 assignments failed; global error: Response-level error: STALE_BROKER_EPOCH. Retrying.'

In namespace chaos-mesh, nine NetworkChaos experiments named otel-demo-checkout-kafka-network-partition-{fkbbr,96js2,c88bd,tfpsw,t2rzv,fnppk,znv8m,j8wrs,dtwx} were Started between 10:02:10 and 10:10:10; each logged 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/checkout-5dccddf8bb-vn95l', 'otel-demo/kafka-ff7884766-xclnk' and 'otel-demo/kafka-ff7884766-skk8d', then 'Time up according to the duration' and 'Successfully recover chaos' roughly 55 s later.
All otel-demo pods are Running, including both kafka pods (kafka-ff7884766-skk8d, kafka-ff7884766-xclnk) and checkout-5dccddf8bb-vn95l with restartCount 0, all started 09:30:42-09:30:44.

At 10:05:22-10:05:24 frontend-proxy also logged 'GET /api/data?contextKeys=... HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream' with a 21-byte body (alongside POST /api/checkout 504 response_timeout lines), a different 5xx class from the checkout timeouts.

The kafka Deployment running two replicas under a single-voter KRaft configuration is the origin of the persistent failure: both pods present themselves as node/broker 1 (quorum voters 1@kafka:9093; brokerId=1 and '[QuorumController id=1]' in logs), the controller rejects the broker epoch (expected 17, got 10) and partition/directory assignments, so the 'orders' topic cannot be created/assigned, checkout's producer fails and opens a circuit breaker, PlaceOrder blocks ~97 s, frontend /api/checkout exceeds frontend-proxy's 15 s upstream timeout, and frontend-proxy returns 504s that raise its request error rate.

The NetworkChaos series otel-demo-checkout-kafka-network-partition-* is a real second fault that amplified the incident after the alert began: its declared checkout<->kafka partition matches checkout's 'i/o timeout' to kafka:9092 at 10:10:49 and the distinct error wave in which frontend-proxy 'router frontend egress' error spans appeared (10:01:41-10:12:41) and 'ingress' errors peaked at 372.2 per 300 s, but it cannot explain the alert's 09:42:41 start.

The 'GET /api/data' 500 via_upstream responses seen at 10:05 are an additional frontend-proxy error source of unknown origin; frontend error spans and frontend logs could not be found, and frontend-proxy ingress error spans continued (83.3 per 600 s at 10:20:41) while checkout had 0 error spans, so this class may keep the error rate above zero after the kafka/checkout wave subsided.

The NetworkChaos experiments cannot be the trigger of the alert: the first one started at 10:02:10, whereas the alert started at 09:42:41 and kafka's StaleBrokerEpochException loop is already logged from 09:48:08 (and error spans from the first returned point at 09:43:41).

A pod-level crash, eviction or OOM is not the cause: both kafka pods and checkout are Running with restartCount 0 and no previous container instance, and the kafka Deployment reports 2/2 ready and available.

frontend-proxy's own error signature is an upstream response timeout (504, 15000-15002 ms, via upstream 'frontend'), and the frontend span for the same request still recorded http.status_code=200, so the proxy is waiting on a slow upstream rather than failing itself.

Traffic volume change as the driver was considered and is not supported: the 20-minute increase of frontend-proxy non-error ('ingress' STATUS_CODE_UNSET) spans stayed broadly flat while error spans rose, e.g. 1358.9 unset vs 88.2 error at 09:44:41 and 10550.8 unset vs 652.3 error at 10:00:41.

Verify the intended Kafka topology: the upstream otel-demo Kafka is a single-node KRaft deployment, so either scale Deployment otel-demo/kafka back to 1 replica or give each broker a distinct node id and a matching multi-voter quorum (and stop advertising one shared 'kafka:9092' identity for both), then confirm 'orders' partitions have leaders.

Confirm whether the Schedule that spawned the nine otel-demo-checkout-kafka-network-partition-* NetworkChaos experiments is expected to run during this window, and check the frontend /api/data 500 route separately, since it is a distinct 5xx source not explained by the Kafka fault.

gaps: The alerting rule 'RequestErrorRate' is not present in this Prometheus: list_prometheus_rules filtered by that rule name returned no rules, so the rule's exact PromQL, its label set and the reported value 1.6 could not be verified or reconciled with the observed ~0.18-1.24 error spans/s for frontend-proxy.

The trace-span error series for frontend-proxy begins at the first returned point 09:43:41, after the alert start 09:42:41, so the pre-alert baseline and the exact instant the signal began to deviate cannot be established.
Jaeger retains only about 09:58-10:00 of traces for this window, so no trace evidence exists for 09:42-09:58 or after 10:00; trace span counts here are samples, not request counts.
frontend-proxy container logs end at about 10:05:33 and the frontend container returned no readable log lines at all, so the origin of the GET /api/data 500 via_upstream responses is unknown.
Change history is not integrated in this Run, so when and why Deployment otel-demo/kafka acquired 2 replicas (all pods in the namespace were created 09:30:42-09:30:44) could not be determined.

NetworkChaos and PodNetworkChaos objects are custom resources that could not be read directly; their existence, targets and timing rest on Kubernetes events only. The kafka broker configuration beyond the Deployment env (e.g. node.id, process.roles, log dirs) could not be read, and secrets are unreadable.
The cause of the recommendation '/flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' error spans (1.28 per 600 s at 10:20:41) was not investigated and may be unrelated background.
next_steps: Compare Deployment otel-demo/kafka against the intended otel-demo manifest (single replica / single-voter quorum) and correct replicas or node ids, then re-check broker epoch stability and topic creation.
Run a Kafka topic/partition describe (kafka-topics.sh --describe) against kafka:9092 to confirm whether 'orders' and '__consumer_offsets' have assigned partitions and leaders.
Check the chaos-mesh Schedule behind otel-demo-checkout-kafka-network-partition-* and decide whether the checkout<->kafka partition is intended during this window.
Collect frontend application logs for the /api/data route to determine why it returns 500 (the 21-byte body suggests a plain 'Internal Server Error').
